entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah, how can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return some cycling shoes. Order number is VF-881-92B. Just tell me if I can get a refund.
Of course. Let me just pull up that order number for you... VF-881-92B. I see the order for the AeroStride cycling shoes. I can certainly check on the return eligibility.
I just need one piece of information for the return reason. Was there a technical fault or was it a matter of preference?
They're causing terrible blisters. I've adjusted the cleats a dozen times and they're still unwearable. I need a refund.

I'm very sorry to hear that the shoes are causing blisters. Thank you for that information. Looking at your purchase date, you are well within the 90-day return period. I can absolutely process this for you.

I have just initiated the return and sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email on your account. Once we receive the shoes, the full refund will be processed. And since you're one of our VIP members, I've also gone ahead and added a $20 credit to your account for the trouble.
Oh. Okay, good. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
